notes.title: Game version 1.0.3 update.
notes.content:
[i][b]v1.0.3[/b][/i]

[b]*Bug Fixes[/b]

・Fixed an issue where EthShard were not displayed correctly in the shop screen due to the 1.0.2 update.

[b]*System Adjustments[/b]

・Added a help section.
You can view game rules, terms, and gameplay tips.
It can be accessed from the book icon to the left of the options icon.

[b]*Balance Adjustments[/b]

・When you reach the boss on the 5th floor, you will receive a specific advantage at the start of the next game.
This bonus only applies to the same character and Extend.
For example, if you are defeated by the 5th floor boss in Extend 2 Gladiator, the bonus will be applied the next time you play at Extend 2 as a Gladiator.
You cannot earn a bonus in Extend 1 and activate it in Extend 5.
Note that if you play with a different character or Extend, your "previous play" will be updated.

・Adjusted the card selection method in the shop.
The first two cards will be drawn based on the type specific to the character being played, while the remaining cards will be drawn as usual.

Please report any bugs that may occur due to this update,
and report if the help section is difficult to understand or if there are any mistranslations.

notes.title: Notice regarding the next update.
notes.content:
[b]The following adjustments and additions are currently being made.[/b]

[i][b]We will add a Help section.[/b][/i]
This menu will allow you to check game rules, terminology, and gameplay tips. It will be placed next to the options icon for easy access.

[i][b]We will add a menu to display a list of cards you have acquired and your completion rate.[/b][/i]
*However, since there is no current data on "cards you have acquired," we apologize but only cards obtained after implementation will be added.

[i][b]We will adjust the card draw method in the shop.[/b][/i]
*For example, for Cryomancer, we will ensure that several Eether-type cards appear.

[i][b]If you reach the fifth boss layer but do not clear it, we will provide some advantages at the start of the next game.[/b][/i]
*For example, you can choose to increase certain stats or increase the initial EthShard.

[i][b]We will fix parts of the UI where the user experience is poor, such as volume adjustment.[/b][/i]

The above implementations will be carried out from this weekend to next weekend and will be updated as soon as they are ready.

notes.title: Adjusted game balance; June 11, 2024
notes.content:
v1.0.2

A small amount of EthShard is now obtained when a treasure is opened.
The amount obtained varies slightly depending on the tier and status.

The amount of EthShard gained from normal enemies has been slightly increased.

The amount of EthShard obtained from Lethal Enemies after the 5th level has been slightly increased.

The amount of EthShard earned from bosses has been slightly increased.

The initial deck of cryomancers has been adjusted.

The effect of the rune “Reversal Luck” has been adjusted.
Old: Drawing the lowest value on a die roll makes the next die roll the maximum value.
New: Drawing 0, 1, or 2 on a die roll makes the next die roll the maximum value.

The effect of the rune “First Token” has been adjusted.
Old: Start the battle with one "HailToken" placed in the GY.
New: Start the battle with one "HailToken", "FrostToken", and "FzB.Token" placed in the GY.

The following runes have been adjusted in terms of their needed EthShard.

Dice Luck+: 600 → 500
Reversal Luck: 400 → 300
Active Draw: 500 → 400
Flying Start: 250 → 150

ATK UP+: 350 → 300
Heavy Blow: 500 → 400
Combo ATK: 400 → 350              

LIFE UP: 100 → 50
LIFE UP+: 200 → 150
Stamina UP: 100 → 50 

MAG UP+: 350 → 300
Strong Magica: 500 → 400

First Block: 150 → 100
Second Block: 150 → 100

SPD UP+: 350 → 300
Steal Blood: 450 → 400

Advanced HailToken: 250 → 150
Hail Reinforce: 350 → 300
Limit Hail: 550 → 500
Advanced FrostToken: 400 → 250
First Token: 150 → 200

We have not received any reports of major problems while playing at this time, but please feel free to report any problems you experience as a result of this update.

notes.title: Beat in Zero, a deck-building roguelike RPG, has been released!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of our deck-building roguelike RPG, "Beat in Zero"! For the first week, the game will be available at a 10% discount. We hope you'll take the opportunity to try it out.

You can find details on controls, specifications, and rules in the [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/2909360/manuals/Beat_In_Zero_English_Manual.pdf?t=1717597307] game manual [/url]. Although the game is designed for players to gradually understand its mechanics and rules through exploration, reading the manual before playing might enhance your gaming experience.

Additionally, guidelines for live streaming and video posting are included at the end of the manual. We greatly encourage gameplay streaming, so please review these guidelines before streaming.

Thank you, and we hope you enjoy "Beat in Zero"!

Manaka GAMES

notes.title: The release date for 「Beat in Zero」 has been decided.
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that our deck-building RPG "Beat in Zero" will be released on Friday, June 7 at 0:00.
We hope you will be able to pick up a copy.

We are also planning to offer a launch discount for about a week after the release.
We will inform you of the details as soon as they are finalized.

notes.title: Beat in Zero Call for Test Play
notes.content:
[h1]■Overview of Beta Test Application[/h1]

[b]How to apply[/b]
1. Direct message to the developer's Twitter account https://twitter.com/milkmonaka_1

2. Direct message to the developer's Ci-en account https://ci-en.net/creator/9472

We will consider a small reward for your cooperation on a first-come, first-served basis.
Please also check the relevant article.
https://ci-en.net/creator/9472/article/1121242

If you apply with either 1 or 2, we will send you a beta key on a first-come, first-served basis up to a certain number of people.

[h1]■Period of Beta Test[/h1]
4/27/2024 - 5/11/2024 (scheduled)

[h1]■Posting and Distribution on Video Websites[/h1]
BEAT IN ZERO will not restrict the posting of videos and still images or real-time video distribution in either the beta test or production version. Please feel free to enjoy the game distribution!

However, if you wish to publish or distribute videos of the beta test, please clearly state so in the summary.
(e.g. "This is the beta test version of the game").
Also, please note that there is a possibility that some problems may occur during the distribution of the video during testing.

[b]For English-speaking people[/b]

This product allows you to change the language during gameplay, but in the beta test, the translation rate was about 80%, which is almost at a level where it is safe to play, but some parts are not translated.

MONAKA GAMES
